title: Canadian Poutine
description: A classic Canadian dish featuring cheese curds, fries, and gravy. Perfect for a quick snack or meal.

ingredients.name: Bowl
ingredients.notes: Large enough for the fries and cheese

instructions: 1. Cut the fries into 1/2-inch thick sticks and fry in hot oil until crispy.
2. Drain the fries on paper towels.
3. In a large bowl, place the fries.
4. Sprinkle the cheese curds over the fries.
